faq.q: How much notice do you need?
faq.a: At least 48 hours before your collection date for boards and platters. The calendar on the order page shows dates that meet that notice and aren't fully booked.
We'll be in touch by text or email to take payment and confirm your order. Nothing is charged automatically. It's fully refundable if you cancel 48 hours or more before collection.
faq.aOnline: You pay for your order in full, securely online by card, when you place it (card payments are handled by Stripe; we never see your card details). That goes for boards, platters, bread, lunch and the deli counter. Your order is confirmed once it's paid, and it's fully refundable if you cancel 48 hours or more before collection.

faq.a: There's a notes field on the order form for allergies or dietary requirements, and we'll confirm with you directly before your collection date. We can't guarantee any item is completely free from a given allergen.

faq.q: Can I change or cancel an order?
faq.a: Get in touch as soon as you can with your order reference and we'll sort it out. If you cancel 48 hours or more before collection, we'll refund you in full. Because everything is made fresh to order, we can't refund cancellations made less than 48 hours before.

officeFaq.q: Do you do office catering near Solihull?
officeFaq.a: Yes — Kelly's Deli is a family-run deli in Bentley Heath, Solihull, and we cater platters and boards for offices across Solihull, Knowle and Dorridge for meetings, team lunches and workplace gatherings.

officeFaq.q: How much notice do you need for a meeting or office lunch?
officeFaq.a: At least 48 hours for a standard order. For a larger one-off event or a regular weekly lunch, get in touch as early as you can so we can reserve your date.

officeFaq.q: Can you deliver to our office, or is it collection only?
officeFaq.a: Office platters can be collected from Bentley Heath. Delivery is available for regular office orders — tell us your postcode and how often you need food, and we'll confirm availability and any delivery cost.

officeFaq.q: Can you invoice monthly instead of paying per order?
officeFaq.a: For regular office lunches we can arrange monthly invoicing — tell us how often you need feeding in your enquiry and we'll set it up with you.

officeFaq.q: Can you cater for dietary requirements and allergies?
officeFaq.a: Tell us about allergies or dietary needs when you enquire and we'll talk through what we can provide before anything is booked. We can't guarantee any item is completely free from a given allergen.

officeFaq.q: How many platters do we need for our office?
officeFaq.a: Each board's size shows how many it feeds. As a rough guide, plan a light platter per 3-4 people if it's alongside other food, or per 2-3 people if it's the main lunch — tell us your headcount and we'll help you get it right.

family.p: Kelly's Deli is run by Mark and Fiona Kelly and their five children, Liam, Abigail, Katie, Cieran and Simone, and we all work in the business. Everything Mark and Fiona buy for the shop, they go out, meet the supplier and try the food first, to make sure it's up to the Kelly's Deli standard before it's sold in the shop.

partyGuide.title: Party Food in Solihull — Grazing Boards & Platters to Order | Kelly's Deli
partyGuide.description: Hosting a party in Solihull or Stratford-upon-Avon? Kelly's Deli makes grazing boards and party platters to order. See what feeds how many, prices, and how to collect with 48 hours' notice.
partyGuide.h1: Hosting a party in Solihull? Here's the food sorted.
partyGuide.answer: Kelly's Deli is a family-run deli in Bentley Heath, Solihull (with a second shop in Stratford-upon-Avon) that has catered over 1,000 parties. We make grazing boards and party platters to order: pick boards to cover your guest list, choose a collection date at least 48 hours ahead, and collect them ready to put on the table.

sections.h: How much party food do I need?
sections.p: Start from your headcount. Every board on our site says how many it feeds. The table below is worked out from our current menu: the boards we would suggest for common party sizes, and what they cost. Not sure? Tell us your numbers and we'll help you get it right.

Pick a board or two sized to your guest list (each one says how many it feeds) and collect it on Saturday from Bentley Heath or Stratford-upon-Avon. Order at least 48 hours ahead; the order calendar shows the earliest day we can still make.

sections.h: How far ahead should I order?
sections.p: At least 48 hours before you collect. Book big parties as early as you can so we can reserve your date. The order calendar shows dates that meet our notice and aren't fully booked.

sections.h: Can I get party food for a Sunday or Monday?
sections.p: Both shops are closed on Sunday and Monday, so Saturday is the last collection day of the week and Tuesday is the first.

sections.h: How do I pay, and can I get a refund?
sections.p: You pay for your order in full, securely online by card, when you place it. Your date is confirmed once it's paid. If you cancel 48 hours or more before collection, you get a full refund.

From either shop: 1 Slater Road, Bentley Heath, Solihull B93 8AQ, or 13 Wood Street, Stratford-upon-Avon CV37 6JF. You pick the shop and the day when you order. For a larger event, ask us about delivery.

sections.h: How do I tell you about allergies?
sections.p: Use the notes box when you order and we'll confirm the details with you before collection day. We can't guarantee any item is completely free from a given allergen.

sections.h: What about the rest of the table?
sections.p: Pre-order bread, baked fresh every day and delivered to us by our own baker. Add salads made fresh every day, or order sandwiches for a lighter spread. Feeding the office instead? See our office catering.

hosting.p: Pick boards sized to your guest list (each one says how many it feeds), order at least 48 hours ahead and collect from Bentley Heath or Stratford-upon-Avon, Tuesday to Saturday. Feeding a bigger crowd? See how much party food you need for 6 to 50 people.

at-home.h: Having a few people round for food?
at-home.p: Our boards for home are made to order for a night in. Each one says how many it feeds, so you can match it to the people coming. Order at least 48 hours ahead and collect from Bentley Heath or Stratford-upon-Avon, Tuesday to Saturday.
